name: Le Hoan
role: Founding emperor of the Early Le dynasty and commander against the Song invasion
known_facts: Was a founding general of the Dinh dynasty and held the office of Thap dao tuong quan
Became emperor in 980 during a severe succession crisis and an imminent Song invasion
Rejected the Song demand that Dinh Toan and Duong Van Nga submit at the imperial court
Personally commanded the 981 defense against Song forces on land and water
Used the Binh Lo defensive position, deception, and converging attacks to defeat Hau Nhan Bao
Led the 982 campaign against Champa after Đại Cồ Việt envoys were detained
Established the royal ploughing ceremony to encourage agriculture
interpretation: A decisive and highly capable ruler whose accession remains historically disputed, but whose military and state-building achievements secured the young independent realm.
unknowns: The full political circumstances behind the deaths of Dinh Tien Hoang and Dinh Lien
The precise role of Duong Van Nga and Le Hoan in the transfer of power
The exact archaeological location and form of Binh Lo citadel
